verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail documents its own mail scanning, cloud storage, and tagging so mail is 'easier to find later'. That gives a thin, glancing form of a findable scanned archive. However, no evidence shows OCR of scanned content or search by sender, content, or date. missing for 10: OCR/text extraction of scans, full-text content search, search or filter by sender, search or filter by date, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an operator, scans are OCR'd and my mail archive is searchable by sender, content, and date

citations.quote: Request to have your mail opened and scanned for convenient online access.
Store and organize all of your mail in one place. Tag your mail so it's easier to find later.
All forwarded documents are scanned and stored as PDF files on the cloud. You'll be able to find and organize all of your legal documents for future reference.
Mail scanning, forwarding, and unlimited cloud storage.
